<thought>Search the template catalog for a retrosynthetic template that breaks a ketone (C=O) and forms an alkane, which corresponds to the Wolff‑Kishner reduction.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "CC(=O)C", 
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketone"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["alkane"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
